hard_gates.name: clean-volume-backup-restore

hard_gates.name: log-content-exclusion
hard_gates.evidence: The final 245-line container log scan found no synthetic credential or uploaded course sentence.

decision.rationale: The corrected images built and passed the complete live HTTPS, clean restore, and original-volume rollback journey. Public DNS, trusted certificate issuance, and target-host rehearsal remain external gates.
limitations: The run used synthetic accounts, one authored PDF, localhost, and one development host.
Caddy used its local CA rather than a publicly trusted certificate.
The clean restore used a separate Compose project on the same host, not the eventual target host.
The result excludes real-course quality, human usability, external generation, concurrency, multi-host scale, and a production SLA.
